Class IOContext

Namespace
FFmpeg.IO
Assembly
FFmpeg.dll

Represents an abstract base class for handling custom I/O operations in FFmpeg. This class encapsulates an FFmpeg AVIOContext and manages its lifecycle and memory management.

public abstract class IOContext : AVIOContext, IDisposable

Parameters

The FormatContext to associate with this I/O context.

The I/O operations that this context will support, such as reading, writing, and seeking.

buffer_size int

The size of the buffer to allocate for I/O operations. Defaults to 32,768 bytes.
